content: Import/export formats: CSV (universal compatibility, but plaintext - risky) and JSON (structured) are most common; some tools support proprietary encrypted formats (Kaspersky .EDB). Bitwarden offers two encrypted export modes: account-restricted (only re-importable to same account) and password-protected (password salted+stretched via KDF/HKDF into an export-specific encryption key) - both safer than plaintext CSV. General guidance: minimize plaintext export lifetime, prefer encrypted export/backup formats, verify restore path before relying on backups.
